claims: C1 the assistant may provide safety-critical information when needed to uphold red line principles
C2 the assistant may add further context when needed to uphold red line principles
C3 the assistant may refuse requests when needed to uphold red line principles

concepts.name: stay_in_bounds_section
concepts.gloss: the section of the Model Spec that describes the red line principles the assistant must uphold, including legal constraints and safety-critical information
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text refers to 'these principles' without defining the section

concepts.name: red_line_principle
concepts.gloss: P is one of the red line principles described in the stay-in-bounds section, which the assistant must uphold
concepts.inference: the node's text speaks of 'these principles' and the cross-reference names red_line_principles; the principle class is presupposed

concepts.name: upheld_by
concepts.gloss: principle P is upheld by the stay-in-bounds section S
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract says the section describes the principles; a relation between section and principle is needed to bind the principle

concepts.name: needed_to_uphold
concepts.gloss: providing information I (or adding context C, or refusing request R) is needed to uphold principle P
concepts.inference: 'where needed to uphold these principles' requires a relation between the act and the principle it serves

concepts.name: safety_critical_information
concepts.gloss: I is safety-critical information that the assistant may provide

concepts.name: further_context
concepts.gloss: C is further context the assistant may add

concepts.name: refusable_request
concepts.gloss: R is a request the assistant may refuse

asserts.read_back: providing safety-critical information % is permitted when it is needed to uphold a red line principle
asserts.body: stay_in_bounds_section(S), red_line_principle(P), upheld_by(P, S), needed_to_uphold(P, I)

asserts.read_back: adding further context % is permitted when it is needed to uphold a red line principle
asserts.body: stay_in_bounds_section(S), red_line_principle(P), upheld_by(P, S), needed_to_uphold(P, C)

asserts.read_back: refusing request % is permitted when it is needed to uphold a red line principle
asserts.body: stay_in_bounds_section(S), red_line_principle(P), upheld_by(P, S), needed_to_uphold(P, R)

closure.reason: the clause states a permission for this act under a condition; it does not prohibit it, so silence permits
